data.name: Khayyat
data.gender_notes: Khayyat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is on a journey or a traveler, originating from the Arabic root 'kh-y-y' which means 'to go', 'to travel', or 'to move'. The name Khayyat carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khayyat usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey of life and the importance of staying focused on the path towards Allah.
data.etymology: Khayyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayyat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خياط
in_arabic.meaning: خياط اسم يعني منسوجات و کثير الخياطة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خياط هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: منسوجات، كثير الخياطة، وصانع الثياب، والمخيط، والخياط هو الشخص الذي يخيط الملابس وينسجها

in_urdu.name: خیاط
in_urdu.meaning: خیاط کا مطلب ہے - خياط، درزی، کپڑے ساڑھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیاط نام کا مطلب ہے جو شخص کپڑے ساڑھتا ہے یا درزی کا کام کرتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عربی زبان سے ہے جہاں خياط (Khayyat) کا مطلب ہوتا ہے - منسوجات، کثير الخياطة، وصانع الثياب

in_hindi.name: ख़य्यात
in_hindi.meaning: ख़य्यात का अर्थ है - दर्जी, कपड़े सीने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़य्यात नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति कपड़े सीता है या दर्जी का काम करता है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं जहां خياط (Khayyat) का अर्थ होता है - सीमस्ट्रेस, एक व्यक्ति जो कपड़े सीता है

in_pashto.name: خیاط
in_pashto.meaning: خیاط دى کپړو د اوبدلو او ګنډلو کارکوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خیاط نوم د داسې یو چا معنی لري چې کپړو اوبدي او ګنډي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی چيرته چې خياط (Khayyat) د يو چا دنده بيانوي چې کپړو جوړوي

in_english.name: Khayyat
in_english.meaning: Tailor, sew, one who sews or stitches
in_english.long_meaning: Khayyat is an Arabic name that refers to a tailor, one who sews or stitches. The term originates from the Arabic root 'kh-y-t' which means 'to sew'. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person skilled in tailoring or sewing

data.cultural_impact: The name Khayyat has deep roots in Islamic culture, with its origin in the Arabic language. The meaning of the name as a traveler or a journeyer holds significant importance as it reflects the spiritual and physical journeys that every Muslim embarks upon throughout their lives. The Islamic tradition provides numerous examples of prophets and companions who were on journeys, such as Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), whose story includes various travels at the command of Allah. Additionally, the concept of the spiritual journey or 'safarat al-nafs' plays a central role in Sufi philosophy and literature, emphasizing the importance of striving for self-improvement and purifying the soul.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the name Khayyat holds immense spiritual significance as it serves as a constant reminder of the journey that every individual undertakes throughout their life towards Allah. This journey, mentioned in the Quran, encompasses both the physical world and the spiritual realm. In the Hadith, it is stated that each person will be asked about their journey in life; therefore, being aware of the ultimate destination and striving to make good choices and make Allah pleased along the way is essential. The Arabic root of the name emphasizes the importance of movement or transformation in the spiritual sense, signifying personal growth and development towards achieving nearness to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Traveler" symbolizes One who is on a journey or a traveler, originating from the Arabic root 'kh-y-y' which means 'to go', 'to travel', or 'to move'.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khayyat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of traveler.
